title: Constant systems preserve flat-term K-flat complexes
statement: Let C be a category with topology J, essentially small in coefficient universe max(c,v,r), and R a commutative ring sheaf. For every K-flat cochain complex P of R-module sheaves with flat terms [def-pc-kflat-complex, def-pc-flat-sheaf-modules], the termwise constant system Delta P over Delta R [def-pur-quotient-constant-system] is K-flat and has flat terms on the vertical sequence site. No varying coefficient ring is involved.

source.place: Tag 0G7E, lemma-pullback-K-flat, applied to the constant-sequence geometric morphism with identity coefficient map; original flat-model proof step 2.

proof.text: The projection precomposition on sets is left adjoint to the cocontinuous sheaf pushforward and preserves finite limits. Its ring and module inverse images have unchanged sections and operations, so they are the recorded constant ring and module functors.

Apply ringed-topos K-flat pullback with identity structural coefficient map to the constant inverse image followed by its normalized identity scalar extension. The scalar unitor identifies this composite with the constant functor; transport K-flatness and flatness through its termwise isomorphism.

theorem quotientConstant_preservesGood
    (P : CochainComplex (Mod.{c, v, max c v r} J R) ℤ)
    (hP : P.IsKFlatIndependentCoefficients) (fP : flatTerms.{c, v, r} J R P) :
    CochainComplex.IsKFlatIndependentCoefficients (R := quotientConstantRing.{c, v, r} J R)
      (((quotientConstant.{c, v, r} J R).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P) ∧
    flatTerms.{c, v, r} (coefficientSequenceTopology J) (quotientConstantRing.{c, v, r} J R)
      (((quotientConstant.{c, v, r} J R).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P)
